title: J065--SERVICE: Maintenance service for Canon Aquilion Exceed CT  SystemBase+4 (VA-26-00023180)
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.248-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 8 (36C248)
detail_text: This is a notice of contract action (NOCA). The purpose of this NOCA is to notify industry of the VA s intent of contact action, using other than competitive procedures for sole source awards to be verified SB concerns, as authorized by VAAR 819.7007. Notice of contract action: Miami VA Medical Center Contracting intends to issue a sole source firm fixed price contract using other than competitive procedures to Canon Medical Systems USA, Inc. for a Maintenance Service Agreement of Proprietary Radiological Equipment. Estimated value of this acquisition is ~$697,037.00~ (If all OY are Exercised). Estimated award date is on or before March 03, 2026. This is not a solicitation for quotes. Information available to the Contracting Officer indicates that Canon Medical Systems USA, Inc., is authorized to provide the required items. Responsible sources may submit a capabilities statement which shall be considered by the agency for future procurements but shall in no way bind the agency. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this NOCA or any follow-up information requests. All information shall be in writing, sent via email. Responses must be received no later than 2:00 PM EST, March 13, 2026.
